sections.title: A steakhouse *with a butcher’s eye*

image.alt: The dining room, with white tablecloths against exposed brick walls

body: Prime is helmed by Chef Chad Jajczyk, whose decades of chef and butchery experience define the kitchen. Black Angus and prime steaks are dry-aged on site for at least twenty-eight days, seafood and whole lobsters are hand-selected, and many ingredients are raised and sourced directly.
Tucked into the heart of downtown Aiken, the dining room pairs modern artwork with old brick walls, lush table settings and a curated bar of premium selections.

Tuesday to Saturday from 5 to 9 pm, and Sunday from 5:30 to 8:30 pm. We’re closed on Mondays.

items.q: Can you host a private party?
items.a: Yes, for up to 55 guests. Call or email primesteakhouseaiken@gmail.com to plan it.

items.q: How long are the steaks aged?
items.a: At least twenty-eight days, dry-aged on site.
